ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Oasis Maker
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
OASIS_MAKER_BUILD_1 (owner ruling, 2026-09-24, verbatim: "machines that create oases slowly when placed near shaded terrain near rocks. Placement is key. We should guide it with green red area selections... Makes obtaining the ancient machines a treasure type."). Spec: design/RimMandrake/oasis_maker_machines_spec.md.
A treasure-class ancient building (`RM_OasisMaker`, minifiable) that, once placed on cold shaded stone, wakes after a short attuning window and then grows an oasis around itself ring by ring, on its own clock — no power, no fuel, no colonist labor. Terrain climbs a stepwise natural ladder (Sand/SoftSand -> Gravel -> Soil -> SoilRich at the margin; Soil -> Mud -> Marsh -> WaterShallow at the innermost ring, forming a real, fishable, stockable pool at the machine's heart) — never floors, never constructed terrain, never existing water, never stone. Placement is guided by a live green/red projected-footprint overlay that recomputes per ghost move, the same shape as vanilla's `PlaceWorker_WatermillGenerator`: red means the hard floor (shaded cells + standing rock nearby) is not met and the machine refuses to place; green shows the oasis the current spot would actually grow, sized and paced by how good the spot is. Interrupting it (uninstall, destruction, losing its shade/rock) freezes growth forever — everything already converted stays; nothing this mod does ever reverses a cell.
**Acquisition (RULED, owner typed, 2026-09-24): "They are sold but very expensive. Same tech as moisture farming itself. You can start a colony with some of those. And priced accordingly."** Not craftable in v1 — the machine is tagged for exotic-goods trader stock (`ExoticMisc`, treasure-class market value) and is an ordinary minifiable buildable, so it is legal starting gear in the scenario editor exactly like any other tradeable minified building. Quest obtain/sabotage hooks are deferred to the quest-design passes per the spec; this mod ships the mechanism only.
Tier: RimMandrake (`RM_`) — works on any map with shade and rock, not tied to any one biome. Feature-gated: Mod Settings carries a master on/off plus every rate and floor number named in the spec (shade/rock floor, attuning length, base ring time, per-ring growth factor, radius cap band).
**Pool integration**: a newly grown `WaterShallow` cell fires the public `RimMandrake.OasisMaker.RM_OasisPoolIntegration.PoolCellCreated` event (map, cell, source="RM_OasisMaker") so a grown oasis registers with the Stocked Pool kit's bookkeeping (`STOCKED_POOL_BUILD_1`, `RM_MapComponent_PoolStock`) exactly like a natural pool once that kit subscribes — see this mod's own rimflow item for the exact contract, since that component did not exist yet when this mod was built.
**Art**: the spec's own build-size table lists the comb-silhouette sprite pass as its own S-sized line item separate from this mechanism sitting (alongside the deferred quest weaves) — this build ships with a placeholder texture pending that pass, tracked in the same item.
